# Assets · Marks

6 files under `assets/Marks/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for mark-07.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Marks

Six geometric marks — a supporting graphic device, **not** the logo. **Ink: black** through `<img>` (`fill="currentColor"`); use the `BrandMark` component or inline the markup to colour them.

Every shape is built from one 90° elbow with a fully rounded inner corner and a square outer corner, repeated, mirrored or rotated. `mark-07` is the bare elbow; the rest combine two or four. They are keyed by their supplied asset number (no names were given). All 50 × 50 except `mark-10` (57.99 × 58.39).

- Use for section dividers, slide corners, empty-state motifs and pattern fills — never to sign a surface in place of the logo.
- Colour: `primary-container` on dark, `brand-obsidian` knocked out of neon, or flat `on-surface` where the accent is already spent.
- One mark per surface; mixing marks in one view reads as a rendering bug.
- Not usable as `mask-image` (C2PA metadata) — `<img>`, inline, or `BrandMark`.
